resources.string: This phone follows the shop\u2019s MAIN PC over the same WiFi router.\nIt never keeps its own copy of the shop data.
MAIN PC address (shown on the main PC screen)
Example: if the main PC shows 192.168.1.10 in its green bar,\ntype 192.168.1.10:8765 here. Only needed once \u2014 after that the phone remembers it.
The shop stays closed on this phone until the main PC answers again. Nothing is invented here \u2014 everything lives on the main PC.
